chapter_title: Blueprint for a Pandemic? DARPA DEFUSE

sources.author: TheSeeker268
sources.title: DRASTIC EXCLUSIVE: Leaked 2018 EcoHealth proposal to DARPA → Project DEFUSE …
sources.summary: DRASTIC tweet announcing the leaked 2018 EcoHealth DEFUSE proposal to DARPA. X skipped under scrape policy.
sources.book_role: Public release moment for the DEFUSE documents that Chapter 14 analyzes.

sources.author: Daszak, Peter
sources.title: DEFUSE proposal
sources.summary: 2018 EcoHealth Alliance DEFUSE proposal to DARPA PREEMPT: engineer SARS-related bat CoVs with novel/human-specific cleavage sites (including furin-like), test chimeras in human airway cells and hACE2 mice at WIV, with Baric UNC work and Yunnan bat sampling.
sources.book_role: Central primary document—the rejected blueprint Chapter 14 argues foreshadows pandemic-relevant research.

sources.author: Markson, Sharri
sources.title: Footage proves bats were kept in Wuhan lab
sources.summary: Sky News Australia video claiming footage shows bats kept in a Wuhan lab. YouTube skipped under scrape policy.
sources.book_role: Visual claim about live bats at WIV—contrasted with Daszak’s denials in s05–s06.

sources.author: Owen, Glen, and Jake Ryan
sources.title: Secret bat cages at Wuhan lab where researchers planned to breed animals for virus experiments
sources.summary: Mail on Sunday report on secret bat cages at a Wuhan lab where researchers planned to breed animals for virus experiments—live-animal infrastructure for bat CoV work.
sources.book_role: Reporting that live bats were part of Wuhan lab plans—context for DEFUSE’s wild-bat inoculation aims.

sources.author: Daszak, Peter
sources.title: “This is a widely circulated conspiracy theory. This piece describes work I'm the lead on & labs I've collaborated w/ for 15 yrs. They DO NOT have live or dead bats in them. There is no evidence anywhere that this happened. It's an error that I hope will be corrected.”
sources.summary: Daszak tweet denying live or dead bats in labs he collaborated with for 15 years, calling bat-in-lab claims a conspiracy theory. X skipped.
sources.book_role: Daszak’s public denial of bats in Wuhan labs—set against DEFUSE and later reporting.

sources.author: Daszak, Peter
sources.title: “Important error in this piece. No BATS were "sent to Wuhan lab for genetic analyses of viruses collected in the field" That's not how this science works. We collect bat samples, send them to the lab. We RELEASE bats where we catch them!”
sources.summary: Daszak tweet insisting only samples—not bats—went to Wuhan labs and that bats are released where caught. Twitter skipped.
sources.book_role: Second denial clarifying sample-vs-animal logistics—Chapter 14 tests against DEFUSE’s wild-bat plans.

sources.author: Lerner, Sharon, and Mara Hvistendahl
sources.title: New Details Emerge About Coronavirus Research at Chinese Lab
sources.summary: Intercept reporting new details from FOIA’d EcoHealth/NIH documents on coronavirus research at the Chinese lab—progress reports and experimental descriptions.
sources.book_role: FOIA-based reporting that fleshes out what EcoHealth–WIV actually did alongside the DEFUSE blueprint.

sources.title: Understanding the Risk of Bat Coronavirus Emergence (FOIA documents; includes EcoHealth Alliance Year-4 Progress Report — reporting period 1.6.2017–31.5.2018; originally filed to NIH 13.4.2018)
sources.summary: Large FOIA dump of the EcoHealth/NIH bat-coronavirus emergence grant materials, including the Year-4 progress report (2017–2018) describing WIV collaborative experiments.
sources.book_role: Primary grant/progress-report evidence of ongoing EcoHealth–WIV work contemporaneous with DEFUSE.

sources.author: Thacker, Paul D.
sources.title: Funding Documents Expose Virologist Danielle Anderson, Once Feted as a "Conspiracy Buster"
sources.summary: Thacker Substack piece arguing funding documents complicate Danielle Anderson’s role as a ‘conspiracy buster’ on Wuhan lab origins.
sources.book_role: Critical counterweight to Anderson’s insider testimony—funding ties in the DEFUSE-era network.
